speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me assess the newborn's yellowish skin discoloration, could you please tell me how many hours old the infant is and when you first noticed the jaundice? Also, is the baby feeding well and having regular wet diapers and stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 5-day-old male newborn. The newborn's mother reports that her child has developed yellowish discoloration of the skin that started from the face and then spread to the trunk since the past day.
